title: Tech-SparkX: Why now is the time for India to create global impact in AI and deeptech
description: Catch Mukesh Bansal in a freewheeling conversation on AI and deeptech R&D, science, innovation, and what it will take to bring bold leadership,and global mindset to India's AI ecosystem.

title: The AI founder DNA: What it takes to build in the AI era
Bootstrapping to bell-ringing: IndiQube’s journey beyond listing
description: From bootstrapped beginnings to ringing the bell at NSE, IndiQube’s journey is a prime example of the evolution of Indian startups. Learn how vision, discipline, and investor alignment helped build an enduring enterprise, and what the next phase of growth looks like in India’s competitive real-estate-tech landscape.

title: India's next-gen tech stack: Engineering intelligence for a billion users
description: AI is changing the art of user journey—evolving from static customer profiles to dynamic, intent-based personalization for every user. How are companies leveraging technology, design, and infrastructure tools to create seamless, intelligent digital experiences?

title: Intelligence in motion: Building AI-ready businesses
description: As enterprises race to become AI-native, CTOs face the challenge of connecting data, models, and decision-making at scale. Hear India’s top technology leaders as they explore how data cloud architectures, governance, and real-time intelligence are powering the next generation of AI-first enterprises.

title: Intelligent health: Building the future of care with AI
description: AI is revolutionising how India experiences healthcare — from diagnostics to last-mile accessibility and at-home testing. But building AI-native health startups requires more than algorithms; it’s about trust and impact. In this session, leading healthtech founders decode what it takes to embed AI at the core to scale care that’s accessible, affordable, and personal.

title: Building innovation: Atlassian’s playbook for the future
description: Paranth Thiruvengadam and Shamik Sharma from Atlassian join Shradha Sharma to explore how Atlassian is deepening its commitment to India by investing in world-class teams across engineering, product, and design. From its bold bets on AI and the future of work with Rovo, to shaping delightful developer experiences and powering collaboration for teams worldwide, discover how Atlassian is driving the next wave of innovation from India.

title: The resilience playbook: Scaling in India’s lending landscape
description: What does it take to build a lending business in one of India’s most competitive and regulated markets? Hear unfiltered stories of grit, pivots, and perseverance, as they decode what it really takes to build, scale, and sustain trust in India’s fast-evolving lending ecosystem.
